title: zingbus Meal Menu: Complete Guide to Food on Bus by Route
summary: The complete zingbus meal menu with prices, available routes, and which meals suit which journey. Pre-book from Rs 99. Delhi to Manali, Lucknow, Varanasi and more
body_markdown:
The zingbus meal menu is a fixed list of pre-bookable, seat-served options available on selected intercity routes. You order before or after booking your ticket, the food is loaded onto the bus before departure, and the marshal delivers it to your berth during the journey. Nothing about highway timing or driver decisions is involved.


## **zingbus Meal Menu: A Complete Overview**


This guide covers the complete zingbus meal menu with all 12 items and prices, the six active routes where Food on Bus is currently live, which meals suit which type of journey, how to add food to your booking, and what the onboard experience actually looks like. This blog adds a journey-by-journey perspective to help you choose the right meal for the right route.


# **zingbus Meal Menu: Food on Bus by Route and Journey Type**


The zingbus meal menu is entirely vegetarian and runs from Rs 99 for a quick bite to Rs 249 for a thali. The twelve items are designed to hold their quality in packaging suited for a moving vehicle, and the most practical choices vary depending on how long your journey is and at what point during it the meal will be served.


## **The Complete zingbus Meal Menu with Prices**


All twelve items currently available on Food on Bus are listed below. Prices are fixed and include the food only; GST may apply at checkout.

Veg Club Sandwich Rs 99


Paneer Kathi Roll Rs 149

The menu covers four broad categories: a light bite (the sandwich), roll and rice options in the mid-range, parantha combos, and the thali as the most complete meal. All items are vegetarian.

## **What to Order Based on Your Route**


The zingbus meal menu works differently depending on how long your journey is and when the meal arrives. Meals are generally served in the first two to three hours after the bus clears the city. Here is what works best on each route type.


### **Short to Medium Routes: Delhi to Kanpur and Delhi to Lucknow**


For journeys of 6 to 8 hours, the meal typically arrives in the early part of the journey. This is usually dinner time for evening departures, or a late-night meal for passengers who board later.


- The Rs 99 Veg Club Sandwich works as a light option for passengers who have already eaten before boarding.
- The Paneer Kathi Roll at Rs 149 is substantial enough for a proper meal and holds well.
- The rice bowls and parantha combos at Rs 149 to Rs 199 are practical choices for passengers who want a filling dinner.


The Premium Veg Thali at Rs 249 is more than most passengers need for a 6 to 7-hour route. It suits those who prefer a complete, multi-item meal.


### **Long Overnight Routes: Delhi to Gorakhpur, Delhi to Katra, Delhi to Varanasi**


These are 10 to 14-hour routes where the meal arrives during the prime sleep window for many passengers. For late-night journeys, a lighter meal before sleep is generally more comfortable than a heavy thali.


- The Paneer Kathi Roll or a rice bowl in the Rs 149 to Rs 179 range is practical for this scenario.
- Heavy parantha combos are best for passengers who depart later in the evening and want a full dinner before sleeping.
- The Dal Makhani Rice Bowl and Butter Paneer Rice Bowl heat and package well for overnight service.


### **The Longest Route: Delhi to Manali**


At 12 to 14 hours, the Delhi to Manali route is the longest Food on Bus corridor and the one where in-bus dining makes the most difference. The meal window typically falls in the evening hours after departure from Delhi, making it a proper dinner situation rather than a late-night snack.


- The Premium Veg Thali at Rs 249 is the most appropriate choice for this route if you want a complete dinner.
- Parantha combos in the Rs 159 to Rs 199 range work well for passengers who prefer a single large item.
- The rice bowls are practical and filling.
- The sandwich at Rs 99 is fine as an add-on but not sufficient as a main meal for a 12-hour overnight journey.


## **How to Order from the zingbus Meal Menu**


There are two ways to add food from the zingbus meal menu to your journey.


**Option 1: During ticket booking**


When booking directly on zingbus (B2C), the food option appears at the checkout stage before payment. Select the item, and it is added to the total.


**Option 2: After ticket confirmation**


Both direct zingbus passengers and those who booked through an OTA platform can add food after booking through the My Trip section of the zingbus app. Log in with the mobile number used for booking, open the journey, select the Food Menu option, choose an item, and pay separately.


For the full step-by-step process, see the[complete meal booking guide](https://www.zingbus.com/blog/zingbus-food-on-bus-intercity-travel-meals/) on the zingbus blog.


## **What Makes the zingbus Meal Menu Practical for Long Routes**


The two most common reasons passengers on long bus routes end up not eating well are unpredictable stop timing and variable highway food quality. Food on a bus removes both variables: you have already seen the menu, chosen and paid for an item, and the food comes to you at your seat regardless of when the driver chooses to stop.


For overnight routes in particular, the dhaba stop scenario typically wakes passengers partway through a sleep window for a rushed meal at a location with no consistency. On a Food on Bus route, the meal arrives while you are awake in the first part of the journey, leaving the sleeping hours undisturbed.

## **Frequently Asked Questions**


### **What is the zingbus meal menu?**


The zingbus meal menu is a fixed list of 12 vegetarian, pre-bookable meal options ranging from Rs 99 for a Veg Club Sandwich to Rs 249 for a Premium Veg Thali, served at the passenger’s seat by the onboard marshal on select intercity routes.


### **How much does food cost on zingbus?**


zingbus meal prices start at Rs 99 for a Veg Club Sandwich; most main course options including rice bowls, parantha combos, and Paneer Biryani are priced between Rs 149 and Rs 199, with a Premium Veg Thali at Rs 249.


### **Which routes have the zingbus meal menu?**


The zingbus meal menu is currently available in Delhi to Lucknow, Delhi to Manali, Delhi to Varanasi, Delhi to Katra, Delhi to Gorakhpur, and Delhi to Kanpur.


### **What is the best meal to order on a long zingbus journey?**


For routes of 10 hours or more such as Delhi to Manali or Delhi to Varanasi, the Premium Veg Thali at Rs 249 or a parantha combo in the Rs 179 to Rs 199 range is the most complete option; rice bowls are practical for overnight routes where a lighter meal before sleep is preferred.


### **Is there a non-vegetarian option in the zingbus meal menu?**


The current zingbus meal menu is entirely vegetarian; no non-vegetarian items are listed in the available menu.


### **Can I order from the zingbus meal menu after booking my ticket?**


Yes, food can be added after booking through the My Trip section of the zingbus app using the mobile number linked to the booking; this option is available for both direct zingbus bookings and OTA-platform bookings.
